blocks.text: The moving caravan reaches a pair of villages, Which were known by the names of Kutabo-Brahmini. Many of the desperate travelers rush toward them hoping for shelter, but the Pathans and hostile villagers treat the arrival as an opportunity for loot and slaughter instead.

Their violence draws Charat Singh back into action once more as he hears the cries of the trapped Sikhs and strikes at the plundering assailants. The page shows how every possible refuge becomes another battlefield, forcing the defenders to rescue their own people again and again.

By the end, both sides are visibly exhausted under the punishing summer sun, and the struggle settles into a grim midday stalemate rather than a clean escape or victory. Even so, the Sikhs continue to fight after taking water and keep dragging the caravan farther from Lahore.
